invariants.01_one_kernel: PASS: publication remediation reuses the existing kernel and real-physics backend.
invariants.02_kernel_separate_from_io: PASS: only runtime publication behavior changed; no I/O was added.
invariants.03_explicit_data_separation: PASS: public results/diagnostics ordering is changed without merging parameters, state, forcing or numerical configuration.
invariants.04_compact_persistent_state: PASS: no persistent state layout or per-column payload changed.
invariants.05_scratch_per_worker: PASS: worker-local solver instances and scratch remain worker-owned; publication reorder is post-reduction.
invariants.06_scalable_memory_layout: PASS_WITH_RESTRICTED_SCALE: internal execution indexing is preserved and public canonicalization does not require canonical internal storage order.
invariants.07_transactional_timesteps: PASS: committed-state identity and cross-column rejection isolation pass; publication reorder occurs after execution/reduction.
invariants.08_cheap_recalculation_warm_start: PRESERVED: deterministic replay passes and no warm-start/state policy changed.
invariants.09_generic_time: PRESERVED: no day/month/year assumption is introduced.
invariants.13_absolute_mass_conservation: PASS: all qualification cases satisfy per-column hard mass residual <= 1e-12 and deterministic aggregate reduction.
invariants.16_multiswap_primary_use_case: PASS_WITH_BOUNDED_SCOPE: real parallel MultiSWAP is exercised for 2,7,8,17,31,32 columns at 2 and 4 workers across multiple batch sizes and input orders; no large-scale performance claim.
invariants.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers_open: PRESERVED: publication ordering is runtime-owned and does not alter the soil-water solver interface.
invariants.21_reuse_swap_physics: PASS: serialized and parallel routes are required to be scientifically identical by column id.
invariants.22_other_modules_not_bound_to_headcalc_i: PASS: canonicalization uses logical column/template ordering, not HeadCalc internals.
invariants.23_physics_and_solver_policy_separate: PASS: no physical option or numerical policy is modified by canonical publication.
invariants.24_predictable_compute_time: NOT_QUALIFIED_AS_PERFORMANCE: true overlap is proven, but speedup or bounded-cost scaling is explicitly not claimed.
invariants.25_reference_mode_available: PASS: serialized reference route remains available and is the scientific identity comparator.
invariants.26_diagnostics_part_of_runtime: PASS: diagnostics are published in the same deterministic canonical order as results without changing diagnostic content.
invariants.27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us: PRESERVED: optional physics is not enabled and no inactive-option state is added.
invariants.28_runtime_coupler_organizes_composition: PASS: canonical result materialization remains a runtime responsibility outside the kernel.
invariants.29_no_silent_dependencies: PASS: the prior silent dependence of public array order on caller input order is removed; unsupported profiles fail closed.
invariants.30_every_architecture_change_tested: PASS: F-MQ28 source lock, immutable prior qualification harnesses, ordering attacks, O0/O2 identity and this explicit audit bind the disposition.
